Hello Prof. Ma,

I hope you are doing great.

First, thank you for sending the two Marketing Science papers. It me helped a lot to position our manuscript for potential MS publication.

Here's what these two papers do:

1. They both sample LLM responses from proprietary LLMs (GPT) to replicate human regression coefficients/treatment effects based on existing open-access human experiments.
2. Both papers position the problem as "LLMs are not good at predicting human responses."
3. Both of their solutions (contribution) is to do some post-inference calibration on GPT responses to make it more similar to humans. In other words, they proposed to take the off-the-shelf GPT, make predictions, and then calibrate those predictions to approximate human samples.

We can aggressively position our work against these two papers. 
First, the problem we are trying to solve is already established by these two recent papers.
Second, our solution is far superior to theirs on different levels:

1. We actually train a model to simulate humans. We don't introduce yet another post-inference calibration method. That would be a genuine contribution.
2. We use open-weight models, which are cheaper.
3. We use decision models, which are faster and more suited for likert/choice tasks.
4. We can benchmark our method on the same dataset as Wang et al. (2026) and show that our open-weight fine-tuned model outperforms proprietary models (e.g., Gemini or GPT) at a fraction of the cost/time.

I have already collected and preprocessed the dataset that Wang et al. used. It's a [COVID dataset](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2771872). 
My initial analysis shows that Kev 9B fine-tuned substantially outperforms Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite in reducing the MSE of the betas estimated from human sample. 
I think this would be our main study.

For Study 2, I plan to use the [Grummon (2025)](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/article-abstract/2840300) nutrition label experiment to add to external validity and position it towards marketing.

Please let me know what your thoughts are. 

Thanks!  
Davood.
